title: A predator's time budget

bodies.name: predator
bodies.label: Predator
bodies.describe: Searches the field, then handles each catch for Th seconds.

lessons.title: Scarce prey
lessons.question: Why does the catch rate level off as prey become common?
lessons.text: With 6 prey on the field, watch how long the predator walks between catches.
lessons.explain: Most of the time goes into searching: catches rise almost in proportion to prey.
lessons.opens: What happens when prey are everywhere?

lessons.title: Abundant prey
lessons.question: What happens when prey are everywhere?
lessons.text: Raise the density to 50 and watch the share of time spent handling.
lessons.explain: Each catch is quickly found but costs Th: handling takes most of the time and the rate nears 60 / Th per minute.

lessons.title: Slower handling
lessons.question: What sets the ceiling?
lessons.text: Double the handling time and compare the catch rate with the ceiling readout.
lessons.explain: The ceiling is T ÷ Th: doubling Th halves the most a predator can eat, as in Ha = aHT / (1 + aHTh).
lessons.opens: How would learning or prey switching change the curve?
